interfaces.clock: Ordered canonical integer hops, actual acquired-sample union; silence counts, missing acquisition and replay do not. ceil(cadence*rate) samples per opportunity. After dispatch skip to the next multiple beyond accumulated samples; no catch-up burst.
interfaces.queue: One latest original endpoint/query-ID per represented group. Query IDs increase within generation. Older endpoints and replayed IDs are reported lost/stale. Replacement preserves admission priority; eligible groups dispatch oldest admission then slot.
interfaces.worker: One outstanding ticket per bus. New pending work does not supersede active or historical completed work. Explicit failure/incomplete result releases the ticket without caching.
interfaces.lifecycle: Retirement/rebinding clears pending/cache and invalidates active result, but holds the worker until acknowledgment. Stale tickets cannot release newer jobs. Increasing generations per reused slot and increasing restart epochs prevent ABA. Actual ancestry and bank handle allocation remain external.

interfaces.coarse_payload: 6272 bytes: fiveu64 IDs, threef64 endpoints;32-byte validity+32-byte approximation bitsets;256 entries ofu64 opaque episode-generation handle,f64cost,f64similarity. Handle0 absent; slot position supplies bank index. Packing uses existing matcher similarity without another exp scan.
interfaces.generation_binding: Caller supplies distinct (episode ID,generation)->(slot,nonzero stable handle). Current slot/handle must match on export. Missing/retired bindings stay absent/unknown; no identity invention.
interfaces.cache: Eight completed snapshots/group. Evict oldest original query endpoint then ID. High-water IDs prevent resurrection after eviction; exact retained replay no-op, conflict rejected. Loss counters distinguish computational eviction from cognition.
interfaces.availability: Cache stores actual result receipt time, not an earlier worker completion. Original full supporting-audio maximum, whole query end, exact occurrence/support and declared generation lineage must qualify at the original commitment cut. Gap tails and later source audio cannot refresh/backdate support.
interfaces.exports: Worker queries and ledger snapshots are detached. Later compression, replacement, retirement and cache eviction cannot change a frozen write. No threaded transport, full memory-bank lifecycle or bounded endpoint ledger is implemented here.
